pages.title: 2020 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring
pages.status: Max messaged them via Cars.com 10/16 asking for availability today, Carfax, and out-the-door price, and to text not call.
verdict: Clean, one-owner, dealer-maintained car; ranks ahead of the Grubbs 2025 CX-5 (likely ex-rental) if the two questions below get good answers.
Carfax value $20,960; Carfax calls the price a Good Value ($343 below).
Get a ~$150 pre-purchase inspection at an independent shop before buying.
pages.carfax_note: Carfax report provided free by Midtown Kia, current as of 10/16/2026.
carfax: No accidents or damage reported; no structural damage, airbag deployment, or total loss.
Clean title: no salvage/junk/rebuilt/fire/flood/hail/lemon brands; no odometer brands or rollback (Carfax-guaranteed).
1 owner, personal use (not rental/lease/fleet), bought new 07/09/2020 at Nelson Mazda, registered in Sand Springs OK, ~6 years, ~13,950 mi/year.
Loan/lien reported on registrations (normal; dealer pays it off).
A service contract was issued at purchase in 2020: ask if it's transferable/still active.
No open recalls. Original factory warranty estimated expired.
Carfax 'Great Reliability' badge (top 25% of similar vehicles, ~$330/yr average repair cost). 19 service records.
concerns: Oil was changed ~every 6,000 mi through 02/2025 (67,272 mi), then no recorded oil change until the dealer's 09/18/2026 service: roughly 18,000 miles / 19 months.
The dealer replaced an unspecified engine seal/gasket before sale.

Alignment, rear brake pads, rotation, transmission fluid flush
Pre-sale service: oil & filter, air & cabin filters, brakes serviced, engine checked, engine seal(s)/gasket(s) replaced

ask: Which engine seal or gasket was replaced on 9/18, and why? Can I see the repair order? (Valve cover gasket = minor; rear main seal, head gasket, or timing cover = bigger concern.)
Was there an oil leak? Any oil burning/consumption noted during the trade-in inspection?
Do you have any oil-change records between Feb 2025 and Sept 2026 (the Carfax shows ~18k miles with none)?
What's the out-the-door price with tax, title, tag and the $589 doc fee? Any add-ons (nitrogen, etching, protection packages) already on it? Ask to remove them.
Is the 2020 service contract from the original purchase still active and transferable?
Are both keys/fobs included? Owner's manual?
Were the brakes replaced or just serviced on 9/18? Pad and rotor measurements?
How old are the tires (DOT date) and how much tread is left?
Can I take it to an independent shop for a pre-purchase inspection before signing?
Is it AWD or FWD? (Confirm on the window sticker/VIN.)
Any warranty or return window from the dealer?
check: Cold start: ask them not to start it before you arrive. Listen for rattles or ticking in the first few seconds.

Under the hood: look for fresh oil wetness or residue around the valve cover and engine edges (signs of the leak that was fixed, or that it's still leaking). Pull the dipstick: oil should be at full, amber-to-light-brown, not sludgy.
Coolant reservoir at the line, no oily film.
Under the car after the test drive: look for drips on the ground.
Dashboard: no warning lights after start (check engine, airbag, ABS, tire pressure).
Test drive 15+ minutes including highway: smooth shifts with no flare or clunk (6-speed automatic), straight tracking, no vibration at 65–70 mph, firm brakes without pulsing or squeal.
Low-speed tight turns both ways in a parking lot: no clicking or groaning.

Electronics: infotainment screen, Apple CarPlay with her phone, backup camera, blind-spot monitoring, heated seats, sunroof, power liftgate, all windows and locks, A/C blowing cold and heat blowing hot.
Tires: matching brand, even wear (uneven inner wear = alignment), DOT date code.
Body: panel gaps even, paint color matches panel to panel, no overspray on trim (Carfax shows no accidents, but not every accident gets reported).
Interior: smell for smoke or mildew, check under the floor mats for dampness.
Match the VIN on the dash and door jamb to JM3KFBDM4L1806106.
Fit: let your daughter adjust the seat and mirrors and check visibility and blind spots.
